_readme: Single place to edit business info, services, gallery projects, pricing and scheduling. Restart the server after editing. Set a pricing rate to a number to turn on dollar estimates; leave it null to show 'Submit for a free personalized quote'.

notifications.note: ownerEmail: every quote request, booking request and proposal reply also emails the owner through this Formspree form (remove the endpoint to turn it off). customerEmail: set to true only if customers are ever emailed; while false the site tells them to check their status link.

business.name: Tedrick Mobile Pressure Washing, LLC
business.tagline: Cleaner Surfaces. Healthier Spaces. A Brighter Tomorrow.

pricing.disclaimer: Estimated pricing is subject to confirmation after reviewing your property, measurements, and surface condition.
pricing.fallbackMessage: Submit for a free personalized quote

scheduling.placeholderNote: These hours and time windows are PLACEHOLDERS so the booking flow works. Set the owner's real hours below and change 'placeholder' to false.

services.label: House & siding soft washing
services.measureLabel: Exterior wall area to wash (sq ft)
services.measureHelp: This is the area of the exterior walls, roughly wall height × the distance around the house. It is NOT your home's floor area (the square footage on a listing). Not sure? Choose "I'm not sure" and we'll assess it.

fields.label: Access issues (optional)
fields.placeholder: Gates, steep yard, tight spaces, no water spigot...

services.label: Roof soft washing
services.measureHelp: This is the surface of the roof itself. It is usually larger than the house's floor area because of slope and overhangs, but it is not the same number. Not sure? Choose "I'm not sure" and we'll assess it.

services.label: Driveway & concrete cleaning
services.measureHelp: Length × width of the area to clean. Use the calculator below if you'd rather enter dimensions.

services.label: Sidewalk & patio cleaning
services.measureHelp: Length × width of the area to clean. Use the calculator below if you'd rather enter dimensions.

services.label: Deck cleaning
services.measureHelp: Length × width of the deck floor. Railings and stairs can be mentioned in the notes.

services.label: Fence cleaning
services.measureHelp: Enter the total length of fence in feet and its average height. If both sides need cleaning, say so in the notes.

services.label: Commercial building & parking lot
services.measureHelp: For buildings, estimate the exterior wall area; for parking lots, length × width of the paved area. Large or multiple areas? Choose "I'm not sure" and we'll arrange an assessment.

services.label: Stain removal
services.measureHelp: Approximate size of the stained area. A small spot can be a few square feet.

serviceCards.title: House & Siding Soft Washing
serviceCards.description: A low-pressure wash that lifts dirt, mildew and algae from siding and exterior walls.

serviceCards.title: Roof Soft Washing
serviceCards.description: Gentle cleaning for roof surfaces without blasting them with high pressure.

serviceCards.title: Sidewalk & Patio Cleaning

serviceCards.title: Deck & Fence Cleaning

serviceCards.title: Commercial Building & Parking Lot Cleaning
serviceCards.description: Clean storefronts, buildings and parking areas for a better first impression.

serviceCards.title: Stain Removal
serviceCards.description: Targeted treatment for oil, rust, tire marks, mildew and other stubborn stains.
